description: This Java class SSLContextCreator is responsible for creating and configuring SSLContext objects based on various connection credentials and trust management configurations. It handles client certificate setup, trusted certificates, hostname verification, and logging related to SSL/TLS setup.

classes.name: SSLContextCreator
classes.description: A utility class implementing CredentialsVisitor to construct SSLContext instances configured with trust managers, client certificates, and hostname verification logic based on connection credentials.

methods.name: withTrustManager
methods.description: Creates an SSLContextCreator with a specified TrustManager for custom trust management.

methods.name: fromConnection
methods.description: Creates an SSLContextCreator based on a connection object, handling certificate verification settings.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an SSLContextCreator configured with specific trusted certificates, hostname/IP, and logging, for flexible SSL context generation.

methods.name: clientCertificate
methods.description: Configures SSLContext with client certificate credentials for mutual TLS authentication.

methods.name: withoutClientCertificate
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext without client certificates, relying solely on trust managers.

methods.name: newTLSContext
methods.description: Initializes a new SSLContext with given KeyManager and TrustManager arrays, using TLSv1.2 protocol.
